title: staurogyne zeylanica
intro: Staurogyne zeylanica, commonly known as Sri Lanka Staurogyne, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae, native to Sri Lanka. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Staurogyne zeylanica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Staurogyne zeylanica and its potential applications in modern medicine.
